def clean(a):
    for i in range(len(a) - 1, -1, -1):
        if a[i] != 0:
            if i == len(a) - 1:
                return a
            return a[:i+1]
    return []

def mulnaive(a, b):
    c = [0]*(len(a)+len(b)-1)
    big = 8*mod*mod
    for i in range(len(a)):
        for j in range(len(b)):
            c[i+j] += a[i]*b[j]
            if c[i+j] >= big:
                c[i+j] -= big
    for i in range(len(c)):
        c[i] %= mod
    return c

mod = 998244353
NTTPrimes = [1053818881, 1051721729, 1045430273, 1012924417, 1007681537, 1004535809, 998244353, 985661441, 976224257, 975175681]
NTTPrimitiveRoots = [7, 6, 3, 5, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 17]

def convoluteSimply(a, b, P, g):
    m = 1 << (2 + (max(len(a), len(b)) - 1)).bit_length() - 1
    fa = nttmb(a, m, False, P, g)
    fb = fa if a is b else nttmb(b, m, False, P, g)
    for i in range(m):
        fa[i] = (fa[i] * fb[i]) % P
    return nttmb(fa, m, True, P, g)

def convolute(a, b):
    USE = 2
    m = 1 << (2 + (max(len(a), len(b)) - 1)).bit_length() - 1
    fs = [None]*USE
    for k in range(USE):
        P = NTTPrimes[k]
        g = NTTPrimitiveRoots[k]
        fa = nttmb(a, m, False, P, g)
        fb = fa if a is b else nttmb(b, m, False, P, g)
        for i in range(m):
            fa[i] = (fa[i] * fb[i]) % P
        fs[k] = nttmb(fa, m, True, P, g)
    mods = NTTPrimes[:USE]
    gammas = garnerPrepare(mods)
    buf = [0]*USE
    for i in range(len(fs[0])):
        for j in range(USE):
            buf[j] = int(fs[j][i])
        res = garnerBatch(buf, mods, gammas)
        ret = 0
        for j in range(len(res)-1, -1, -1):
            ret = ret * mods[j] + res[j]
        fs[0][i] = ret
    return fs[0]

def nttmb(src, n, inverse, P, g):
    dst = src[:n]
    h = n.bit_length() - 1
    K = (1 << h) * 2
    H = ((K.bit_length() - 1) * 2)
    M = (K * K)//P

    wws = [0]*(1 << (h - 1))
    dw = pow(g, P-1 - (P-1)//n, P) if inverse else pow(g, (P-1)//n, P)
    w = (1 << 32) % P
    for k in range(1 << (h - 1)):
        wws[k] = w
        w = modh(w*dw, M, H, P)

    inv_n = invl(P, 1 << 32)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(1 << i):
            s = j << (h - i)
            t = s | (1 << (h - i - 1))
            for k in range(1 << (h - i - 1)):
                s_idx = s + k
                t_idx = t + k
                u = (dst[s_idx] - dst[t_idx] + 2*P) * wws[k]
                dst[s_idx] = dst[s_idx] + dst[t_idx]
                if dst[s_idx] >= 2*P:
                    dst[s_idx] -= 2*P
                Q = ((u << 32) * inv_n) >> 32
                dst[t_idx] = (u >> 32) - Q * P + P if (u >> 32) - Q * P < P else (u >> 32) - Q * P - P
        if i < h - 1:
            for k in range(1 << (h - i - 2)):
                wws[k] = wws[k*2]

    for i in range(n):
        if dst[i] >= P:
            dst[i] -= P
    for i in range(n):
        rev = int('{:b}'.format(i).zfill(h)[::-1], 2)
        if i < rev:
            dst[i], dst[rev] = dst[rev], dst[i]
    if inverse:
        in_val = invl(n, P)
        for i in range(n):
            dst[i] = modh(dst[i] * in_val, M, H, P)
    return dst

def garnerPrepare(m):
    n = len(m)
    if n == 0:
        return []
    gamma = [0]*n
    for k in range(1, n):
        prod = 1
        for i in range(k):
            prod = (prod * m[i]) % m[k]
        gamma[k] = invl(prod, m[k])
    return gamma

def garnerBatch(u, m, gamma):
    n = len(u)
    v = [0]*n
    v[0] = u[0]
    for k in range(1, n):
        temp = v[k-1]
        for j in range(k-2, -1, -1):
            temp = (temp * m[j] + v[j]) % m[k]
        v[k] = (u[k] - temp) * gamma[k] % m[k]
        if v[k] < 0:
            v[k] += m[k]
    return v

def modh(a, M, h, mod):
    r = a - (((M*(a & ((1 << 31) - 1)) >> 31) + M*(a >> 31)) >> (h - 31)) * mod
    return r if r < mod else r - mod

def invl(a, mod):
    b = mod
    p, q = 1, 0
    while b > 0:
        c = a // b
        d = a
        a, b = b, d % b
        d = p
        p, q = q, d - c * q
    return p if p >= 0 else p + mod
